referee_caveats_inferred: Treat total dust masses as conditional extrapolations, rather than direct measurements of the optically thick inner disk.
Assess sensitivity of grain-size and mass posteriors to adopted dust composition and temperature priors.
A flux-calibration offset is shared across radii; treating it only as a per-radius error may omit correlations important for integrated masses.
Clarify the inconsistent large-grain upper bounds: the initial grid reaches 100 cm, while the posterior split states 10 cm.
Check the stated grid counts against bounds and increments before implementing them.
The small-grain discussion associates gravitational instability with Q>1, contrary to its own Q=1 threshold discussion; resolve this textual inconsistency.
Direct evidence for gas pressure bumps, streaming instability, or planets is not supplied by continuum fitting alone.
